summary: All iteration-3 flows pass end-to-end. Backend (5 new pytest cases in test_suggestions_barcode.py + 32-total suite): POST /api/ai/meal-suggestions {meal:'jantar', date:'2026-01-15'} returns {meal, remaining{cal,prot,carb,fat}, suggestions[]}; every item has source=='taco', its name is in TACO_FOODS, and includes computed macros + grams + code; totals are numeric. GET /api/foods/barcode/7891000100103 returns Leite Condensado Moça (brand Nestlé, 325 kcal/100g, serving 20 g); unknown 0000000000000 returns 404; missing auth returns 401. Full previous suite (32/32) still green. Frontend (390x844 web preview, token-authed): (1) Dashboard open-suggestions -> /suggestions -> sugg-meal-jantar -> generate-suggestions -> 3 suggestion-cards + remaining-card (1798 kcal / 145 g prot restantes) rendered after ~10 s AI call; add-suggestion-0 ('Frango com arroz, feijão e salada', 542 kcal) added 5 TACO items (Peito de frango 180 g, Arroz integral 120 g, Feijão carioca 100 g, Brócolis 100 g, Alface 50 g) to meal_jantar for today, button turned 'Adicionado ✓', toast 'Refeição adicionada ao Jantar', verified in Diary tab (meal-jantar section shows all 5 entries, 542 kcal). close-suggestions returns to dashboard. (2) Dashboard open-barcode-dashboard -> /barcode -> manual code 7891000100103 -> barcode-product shows 'Leite Condensado Integral moça · Nestlé · 325 kcal / 100g'; grams->80, barcode-meal-lanche_tarde selected, barcode-add -> toast + resets to scan state; invalid 00000000 shows 'Produto não encontrado' toast and keeps scan state; barcode-scan-again resets after a valid lookup; close-barcode returns to dashboard. (3) add-food header icon open-barcode navigates to /barcode. (4) Regression: calorie-card, water-widget, quick-add-food, open-assistant all render on dashboard. Only non-blocking warnings: pointerEvents deprecation and scrollable-ref already noted in iteration_2.

react_native_issues.issue: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' warning still present on web preview (library-level: react-native-reanimated / gorhom bottom-sheet). Non-blocking, carried over from iteration_1.

action_items: No functional fixes required. Optional cleanup: suppress remaining 'pointerEvents' deprecation warning (noisy on web) by migrating any first-party usages to style.pointerEvents; the ones in app/barcode.tsx (lines 185-186) already use style, so remaining warnings come from libraries.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py L835 /api/ai/meal-suggestions: good constraint — forces LLM to return only TACO names and filters with find_taco(); any hallucinated item is dropped. Response is deterministic in shape even if LLM returns 0-3 items; frontend handles 0 by showing 'não consegui montar sugestões' toast.
server.py L400 /api/foods/barcode/{code}: delegates to OpenFoodFacts with product_name_pt preferred — Leite Moça resolves correctly. 404 is properly raised; auth required.

suggestions.tsx L50 add mutation does N serial POST /diary calls (one per item). For 5 items this took ~1.3 s in the test. Acceptable but could be batched with POST /diary/batch if latency becomes an issue.

barcode.tsx: web branch (Platform.OS==='web' || !permission.granted) correctly shows manual entry only; disables search button when len<8; sets grams from product.serving when numeric. All testIDs present and reachable.
server.py is now 991 lines — soft 700-line limit still exceeded; splitting into routers overdue (also noted in iteration_2).

In suggestions.tsx L147 the `add.isPending && add.variables?.id === s.id` check uses the suggestion id, but add.mutate is called with the Suggestion object — the comparison works because s is passed and used as mutation variable, so loading spinner only shows on the tapped card. OK.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (suggestions E2E, barcode manual E2E with error toast, add-food->barcode entry, dashboard regression)

seed_data_creation: No new seed required; used onboarded test user via token test-token-nutrify-123. Test added 5 jantar entries + 1 lanche_tarde entry to the real diary for 2026-10-20 (user_testnutrify1) — can be cleaned by running `python /app/backend/seed_test.py` if desired.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Native camera scanning cannot be tested on web — only manual entry is reachable (correct per spec). Diary entries use testID='delete-{entry.id}' (no 'diary-entry-*' id) — select rows via the delete testID or by text inside '[data-testid="meal-{meal}"]'. The /suggestions AI call takes 8-15 s on gpt-5.5; use timeout>=60 s. Running /api/ai/meal-suggestions can occasionally return 0 suggestions if the LLM strays outside TACO names (filter is strict); re-run resolves it.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found this iteration.
